title: PECARN
subtitle: Paediatric head-injury risk pathway
summary: PECARN distinguishes very-low-risk and observation groups. It should not be reduced to one generic checklist or used outside the validated paediatric population.
population: Separate under-2-year and age-2-or-older pathways, including mental state, skull-fracture signs, mechanism, vomiting, loss of consciousness, headache and parental assessment of behaviour.
exclusions: Do not enter assumed normal results.
overrides: Follow the applicable NICE, local emergency department or specialty pathway.
limitations: PECARN distinguishes very-low-risk and observation groups. It should not be reduced to one generic checklist or used outside the validated paediatric population.
